caseName: Dooley v. Korean Air Lines Co.
caseNameFull: Dooley, Personal Representative of the Estate of Chuapoco v. Korean Air Lines Co., Ltd.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, February 23, 1998. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, March 25, 1998. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 8 p.m., Friday, April 10, 1998. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
